original_query: What is a term that refers to the way work is assigned to the team?

summaries.found_via_query: term for how work is assigned to a team
summaries.summary: The image compares 'Command and Control' with 'Self-Organizing' team structures. Under 'Command and Control', it defines 'Command' as the way work is assigned to the team rather than the team deciding together. It also defines 'Control' as how changes are handled with a project manager monitoring and updating the plan. Under 'Self-Organizing', it states that everyone plans together to figure out what work needs to be done, with each person taking on the work during the sprint.
key_facts: Command refers to the way work is assigned to the team rather than the team deciding together.
Control refers to how changes are handled, with a project manager monitoring and updating the plan.
On a self-organizing team, everyone plans together to figure out what work needs to be done, and each person takes on the work during the sprint.
visible_text: Command refers to the way work is assigned to the team rather than the team deciding together.
Control refers to the way changes are handled, with a project manager constantly monitoring the project and updating the plan when changes are discovered.
On a self-organizing team, everyone plans together to figure out what work needs to be done. During the sprint, each person takes on the work that the project needs.
